ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized to scarring and abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark base with sparse, high-contrast white blobs and streaks distributed non-uniformly across both lobes. A concentration of white pixels is observed in the mid-section of the left lobe and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 110-120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Densely packed, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Notable high-amplitude peaks (jaggedness) are present on the right lobe trailing edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve from the central notch towards the distal tips, which exhibit an upward sweep trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of small circular white pixels (barnacle scars) distributed primarily in the medial and lower regions of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear marks present; specifically, a long diagonal scratch on the left lobe and several shorter vertical rake-like marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and surface abrasions across the ventral area. Significant irregular indentation on the right fluke tip trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density white pixel cluster forming a mottled patch near the far left distal tip.
